from tools import *
import json,time,subprocess,sys
I={'name':'I','kind':'int','bits':8};A={'name':'A','kind':'array','element':'I','size':4096};B={'name':'B','kind':'bool'}
def v(n):return ['var',n]
c=base(types=[I,A,B],modules=[{'name':'m','params':[['a','A']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':['all','x',v('a'),['eq',v('x'),['const','I',0]]]}],entries=['m'])
runs=[]
# 400 runs -> expected objects ~1.64M
for k in range(400):
 objs={f'x{i+1}':b'\0' for i in range(4096)};objs['x4097']=b'\0'
 runs.append({'entry':'m','ktest':ktest(objs)})
c['runs']=runs
data=json.dumps(c,separators=(',',':')).encode();print('input MB',len(data)/1e6)
t=time.time();p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE);print('rc',p.returncode,'time',time.time()-t,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:200]);
if p.returncode==0:
 o=json.loads(p.stdout);print(len(o['records']),{r['status'] for r in o['records']},len(o['corpus']))
